name: Kazegahara Gakuen Spy-bu!
original_name: 風ヶ原学園スパイ部っ！
source:
Kyouichirou belongs to a strange club at Kazegahara Academy called the ‘Spy Club’. It’s not actually a real club, but an unofficial one. The club members are all very eccentric: the club leader Chikae, unrivalled in leadership; his childhood friend Karin who is a hacker; super-mechanic underclassman Uta; and reckless, ex-gymnastics ace Haruna. They go around the school every day, completing various missions. One day, a strange person by the name of ‘Ghost Dog’ who causes mischief in the school. They start a mission to uncover ‘Ghost Dog”s true identity, but the student council is watching their every move in the shadows…

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/11/04/november-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
恭一郎隶属于风原学园一个名为“间谍部”的奇怪社团。它其实并非正式社团，而是一个非官方组织。成员个个性格独特：拥有非凡领导力的部长千景；身为黑客的青梅竹马花梨；机械技术超群的学妹歌；以及莽撞的前体操王牌春菜。他们每天在校园里四处行动，完成各种任务。一天，一个名叫“幽灵犬”的怪人在校内到处恶作剧。他们开始执行任务，试图查明“幽灵犬”的真实身份，学生会却在暗处监视着他们的一举一动…
